title: A Living Sacrifice
speaker: Ryan Baird
summary: Our spiritual worship is offering our whole lives to God every day: our hands, our voices, our money, our wills and our hearts.
exhortation: Your spiritual worship is presenting your body as a living sacrifice every day: putting self to death, putting to death the desires of our hearts, and living holy for Jesus. That is our spiritual worship.

The next song we're going to sing is called "Take My Life and Let It Be." It's a beautiful old hymn. I don't know if the writer had this verse in mind, but when I read Romans 12:1, I think of that song. What does it mean for my life to be a living sacrifice and spiritual worship? Take it all, Lord. Take it all.

So as we sing this song verse after verse, my prayer for you and for myself is that it would be a prayer of mission, that our lives this morning would be living sacrifices for Jesus. Lord, take my life, every moment of every day. Take my hands and my feet, my every movement, for your glory. Take my voice, my lips, my speech and my song. Take my money, my gifts and my wealth. Take my will, my heart and my love. Let it all be ever unto you and for your glory.
prayer: Lord, that is our prayer: that you would have it all. What a glorious thought that one day sin will be gone, and we will be wholly yours in your presence. As we wait for that day, I pray that you would make us more and more like you. Let the chains of this world fall off, and by your grace may we grow in holiness, more and more in love with you, finding all our joy in you, and giving all our resources to you, who give so freely. Take it all, Lord. We pray in Jesus' name. Amen.
